title: YUB-928: Ewok Galaxy Forager
description: A 1978-style blue-and-grey delta explorer reimagined as an Ewok's flying den: twin amber eye canopies, a sculpted rust-orange hood, round ear scanners, timber engine jackets, four bear-paw landing feet and an open rear sample bay with boarding ramp. The spacecraft stands on its own paws.

sections.name: Blue radiator panels and lashed timber spars
Ewok hood and amber binocular cockpit
Twin log-jacket engines and blue tail fins
Open sample bay and raised blue hatch
